title: File the annual unclaimed property holder report (Florida)
description: Businesses holding property that has gone unclaimed — uncashed payroll or vendor checks, customer credits and refunds, unused gift cards, deposits — must report and turn it over to the state each year, after sending the owner a due diligence notice before the deadline. The annual report and payment are due April 30 for general property. A negative report is required even when the business holds nothing. The state's portal gives April 30; the national directory says May 1. Which state's law applies depends on the owner's last known address, or the business's state of incorporation when there is none, so a business can owe reports to several states.
